messages:
aisling: Noticing regressions on /datasets/* when annotation-heavy pages load. LCP up ~180ms and jank on first interaction. Saw spike after yesterday's UI split that pulled toolbar styles into a separate chunk. Traces attached.
omar: Can you share a sample request id and whether it's localized pages only?
aisling: sample req prod:rq_7c3a9, page /datasets/beta/annotations?locale=fr. Seen in eu + us.
kevin: I grabbed the trace for rq_7c3a9 1710273000 range1: main-thread parse + style recalc is the big hit, plus a 95kb icon font load blocking paint.
sasha: Build delta from last deploy:
```
annotation-toolbar.css.chunk: 172.9kb
annotation-toolbar.js.chunk: 42.1kb
common-icons.woff2: 108.4kb
```

sasha: Previously toolbar CSS was critical and small (~8kb inlined). The split plus full icon font is the new cost.
omar: Did any rollout weights change for EU? We adjusted routing for localization last week. That could increase the number of page hits pulling the i18n chunk.
aisling: Yes, routing weights changed: eu_locale_canary 0.05 -> 0.25 on 1716760000.
ci-bot: deploy success 1716772000 0c8e1a00 0annotation-toolbar: split toolbar css + icons
deploy-bot: canary ramp eu 5% -> 25% at 1716776000
kevin: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) re-inline critical toolbar CSS to reduce parse, 2) subset icon font to only used glyphs, 3) lazy-load toolbar on first hover/click, 4) reduce telemetry noise on annotation routes.
sasha: Subsetting font should be quick and might shave ~80kb. I can prepare subset and run CI.
omar: Which telemetry change would reduce main-thread work? We enabled higher interaction sampling for annotations for the experiment.
aisling: telemetry-config shows sample_rate went from 0.04 -> 0.2 for experiments/anno on 1716758000. That explains more callbacks on load.
kevin: For rq_7c3a9, instrumentation callbacks were ~70ms. Dropping the sample back should help immediately.
aisling: I'll push a server-side revert to sample_rate 0.04 for that experiment now.
ci-bot: PR created r/redwood/infra#1147 0telemetry revert for annotation sampling
ci-bot: PR created r/redwood/console#4902 0lazy-load toolbar behind flag
sasha: Quick A/B plan: gate lazy-load with feature flag toolbar_lazy; default true for canary only. If that reduces LCP and TTI we can roll to prod.
omar: Also consider a small perf CI check: fail if any new chunk adds >40kb to critical path bundle.
kevin: Agree. I'll prototype a premerge check that compares changed bundles against baseline artifact sizes.
aisling: Actions now: 1) apply telemetry revert (infra PR), 2) enable toolbar_lazy in canary cohort (console PR), 3) subset icon font and ship follow-up. I'll report metrics after each.
deploy-bot: actioned: telemetry revert applied at 1716781200
aisling: Quick update (1716783000): after reverting telemetry sampling, median LCP on the failing route dropped ~100ms in canary. Interaction jank improved but some parse time remains.
sasha: Subset font patch is ready. Font subset cuts icon file from 108kb -> 22kb. CI run green.
ci-bot: merge r/redwood/assets#2215 0subset icon font
kevin: Once lazy-load is enabled for canary and subset font goes live, LCP should be near baseline. If not, we should consider re-inlining critical CSS.
omar: Postmortem items: 1) require perf review for chunking CSS out of critical path, 2) tighter gating for routing weight changes that amplify canary exposure, 3) add per-route main-thread breakdown to perf dashboard (parse/script/paint) and a chunk-size watchdog in CI.
aisling: Scheduling a short sync tomorrow with eng-platform + devex to finalize packaging rules. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
